dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shape profile with the posterior edge of the band tapering toward the tail at the dorsal midline
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial band thickness at the lateral flanks, narrowing slightly at the midline

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear gap between ear regions approximately equal to the horizontal width of an individual pinna
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular apex curvature on both visible ears

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular reddish-brown lesion or patch of significant fur loss located on the lower back/rump region
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan discoloration of the white fur across the posterior dorsal and lateral regions
